text:
Maria: Heads-up — last night's 02:15 UTC latency spike burned ~30% of the weekly error budget for the hosted inference tier. We need a short remediation plan + owners. :eyes:
Ajay: Saw it in the dashboard. p95 went from 120ms -> 560ms for ~12m. p99 worse. Looks correlated with a single inference pool hitting NVMe IO pressure.
Claire: Agree. Also noticed backend queuing increased at the same time. Could be autoscaler lag + cold cache hits.
Dan: Can we avoid immediate SLA change? I think we should adjust SLO windows and add a short-term compensating rule before changing customer-facing SLA text.
Maria: Proposal:
- Reset weekly error budget by +15% to avoid noisy alerts while we fix root cause
- Create tactical mitigation (increase pool size and enable faster warmup) for 48h
- Long term: add NVMe IO metrics to SLO dashboard, add auto-throttle to RG scheduler
Ajay: I can own tactical mitigation. Will schedule capacity bump and tweaked warmup. Target: complete today EOD UTC.
Claire: I'll update dashboards and add an alarm on NVMe avg latency + queue depth. Grafana query I'm going to add:
```promql
sum(rate(inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, pool)
```
(not exact, will tweak)
Dan: I'll draft the SLO window adjustment note for customers and the internal change log. Suggest we change p95 target from 150ms -> 200ms for a 7-day rolling window, re-evaluate after 2 weeks.
Maria: Owners + tickets:
- AJAY: INF-3372 increase pool & warmup (due: today EOD)
- CLAIRE: INF-3373 dashboard + NVMe alerts (due: +48h)
- DAN: INF-3374 SLO comms + SLA wording (due: +3d)
- MARIA: INF-3375 playbook update + follow-up retro (due: +7d)
Ajay: INF-3372 created and assigned to me. ETA 6pm UTC. Will post runbook steps once done.
Claire: INF-3373 created. Adding dashboard panels: NVMe latency, IO ops/s, scheduler queue length, and a one-click drilldown to slow traces.
Dan: INF-3374 created, adding a short note to the customer-facing SLA draft about transient capacity events; will not change core SLA numbers without legal signoff.
Maria: Quick check — do we want to temporarily silence paging for the weekly errorbudget alert while we enact the mitigation?
Ajay: Yes, please mute the pager rule for 6h while I complete the bump. Leave slack alert only. :+1:
Claire: Muted alert for 6h and added a note to the alert with links to INF-3372/3373.
deploy-bot: Scheduled a capacity increase job for pool-3 at 18:05 UTC to add +2 nodes (rolling).
Maria: Thanks. Follow-up sync Friday 10:00 UTC to review metrics and decide on permanent SLO changes. I'll own the retro and action verification. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Dan: I'll also add a recurring check in the SLO dashboard for the next 4 weeks to monitor for recurrence patterns (weekly spike around 02:00?).
Ajay: One more: let's add KV-prefix caching for popular prompt prefixes to reduce backend IO on hot paths — low-risk experiment. I'll attach results to INF-3372.
Claire: Noted. If anyone sees any new anomalies after the capacity bump ping here and tag @oncall.
Maria: Great work team. Closing plan for now; will reopen thread if anything unexpected pops up.
